summary: Generative AI and chatbots enhance intrinsic motivation, engagement, and confidence in language learning by fostering creativity, reducing anxiety, and promoting interactive, low-pressure environments.
AI tools like ChatGPT and LLMs provide immediate, personalized feedback, adaptive scaffolding, and automated assessments, improving learning outcomes while reducing teacher workload and bias.
Generative AI improves second language writing through error correction, feedback on complexity, and personalized tutoring, enhancing accuracy, creativity, and learner confidence.
Generative AI serves as a versatile resource in language education, supporting teaching efficiency, personalized learning, and on-demand assistance for both educators and learners.
